evidence.scope: The VolFee v4 hook source at the exact reviewed revision: afterInitialize pool binding, the per-swap EWMA-volatility LP-fee override, and the mandatory quadrant-dependent Programmable volume-fee accrual and claim paths.

Stateful invariant suite over fuzzed swap sequences: the LP fee stays inside its immutable bounds, the hook ERC-6909 quote balance equals programmableFeeOwed plus projectFeeOwed, and the hook lastTick tracks the pool tick.

The single-use atomic launcher source: it deploys the token and hook as CREATE2 children, initialises the canonical dynamic-fee pool, seeds one full-range position, and returns residual balances to the launch wallet.
The exact builder submission model used to recompute the mandatory Programmable volume-fee projection, the derived hook permission mask, and the four-quadrant fee-collection paths.
The fixed-supply ERC-20 token source minted once to the launcher in its constructor, with no owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, or upgrade path.

The mandatory-fee unit suite: dynamic-fee-pool binding, the fixed 10-bps platform basis across all four swap quadrants, executed-not-requested basis, owner-only and project-only claim authorisation, and solvency reconciliation.
